name: My Kit, Ranked by Daily Use
why_it_works: Gear lists are voyeuristic: people love seeing what a working pro actually carries. Ranking by how often each item is used, not how expensive it is, makes the list honest and relatable, and the cheap item that ranks first becomes the shareable surprise.

hook.pattern: Open the bag on camera and promise the ranking will surprise.
examples: My {{kit_name}}, ranked by how often I grab it.
My most-used piece of gear cost {{cheap_price}}.
Dumping my {{kit_name}}. Number one will embarrass me.

craft.notes: Ranking by use instead of price lets the cheapest, most beaten-up item win, which is both honest and funny. The worn texture of number one is the visual payoff, so the still must show real wear, not a fresh product shot.

do_not: Turn the list into undisclosed sponsored placements; disclose any paid or gifted gear
Show real brand logos prominently on the gear
Rank by price; it kills the twist
compliance: Fitness and athletes: no claims that any gear guarantees weight loss, strength or body results
Disclose any paid, gifted or affiliate gear clearly, following FTC endorsement rules
Fitness gear: results vary; no FDA, disease or body-result claims for any item shown
